test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
For your safety at work, which of the following should be ensured?

1. All the required protective clothing and equipment are used.

2. Training and instruction necessary for performing tasks safely have been received.
solution:
The correct answer is __Both statement 1 and 2.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Protective clothing and equipment__ are essential for ensuring safety at the workplace.
 
• All necessary safety equipment must be used to minimize risks of injury or hazards.
 
• __Proper training and instruction__ are required to ensure that tasks are performed safely and efficiently.
 
• Safety training helps in identifying and preventing potential hazards.
 
• Both protective equipment and safety training together create a safer work environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Workplace Safety Measures:**

 
 
• Regular safety inspections and audits help in identifying potential risks.
 
• Emergency response plans should be in place to handle unforeseen situations.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Training:**
 
 
• Training ensures that employees are aware of safe practices and protocols.
 
• It helps in reducing workplace accidents and improving overall productivity.
